Eat it to gain a temporary boost to your heat resistance.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== Frozen Crabs are a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make Frozen Crabs by exposing [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s to [[Freezing Climate]]s or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They are noted not to offer much companionship, but they are guaranteed to not spoil. Eating one will restore one [[Heart]] to Link's [[Life Gauge]] and grant temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Blackened Crab * Crab * Food * Frozen Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW }}
